recipes.title: Warm Black Bean, Soft Egg & Cilantro-Lime Breakfast Bowl
recipes.summary: Cozy Southwestern morning bowl pairing warm black beans seasoned with dried cilantro and cumin, soft scrambled eggs, avocado, and lime.

ingredient_details.item: dried cilantro leaves (or 2 tbsp fresh chopped)

steps: Warm black beans with dried cilantro, cumin, and 2 tbsp water in a small skillet 2 minutes, then spoon into a bowl.
In the same skillet, warm olive oil and gently scramble beaten eggs 3 minutes until soft.
Nestle eggs beside the seasoned beans, add sliced avocado, and squeeze fresh lime over top.
tips: Dried cilantro leaves wake up quickly in warm, moist dishes like beans and eggs and stay handy in the pantry all year.
Top with an extra pinch of fresh or dried cilantro right before eating.

recipes.title: Creamy Avocado, Lime & Cilantro Whole-Grain Toast
recipes.summary: Whole-grain toast spread with bright smashed avocado, fragrant dried or fresh cilantro, fresh lime juice, diced tomato, and pumpkin seeds.
steps: Mash ripe avocado with fresh lime juice, cilantro, and a pinch of salt; rest 2 minutes so dried cilantro rehydrates softly.
Spread generously onto warm whole-grain toast.
Top with finely diced tomato and toasted pumpkin seeds.
tips: Letting dried cilantro sit 2 minutes in lime-avocado mash softens the herb completely.
Add a poached egg on top for extra staying power.

recipes.title: Savory Cilantro-Lime & Spinach Breakfast Oatmeal
recipes.summary: Warm vegetable-broth rolled oats infused with dried cilantro, baby spinach, lime juice, olive oil, and a soft-cooked egg.
steps: Simmer rolled oats, vegetable broth, and dried cilantro 6 to 7 minutes until tender and creamy.
Fold in baby spinach until wilted, then stir in fresh lime juice and olive oil.
Spoon into a warm bowl and nestle a soft-cooked egg on top.
tips: Simmering dried cilantro directly in broth blooms its warm herbal citrus aroma cleanly.
Soft, warm, and naturally whole-grain.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato, Black Bean & Cilantro Morning Skillet
recipes.summary: Tender diced sweet potatoes warmed in olive oil with sweet corn, black beans, mild dried cilantro, garlic, and bright lime.
steps: Warm olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and saute sweet potato cubes and corn 5 minutes until golden.
Stir in rinsed black beans, minced garlic, dried cilantro, and 2 tbsp water and simmer 3 minutes until fragrant.
Remove from heat, brighten with fresh lime juice, and serve warm.
tips: Works wonderfully on its own as a plant-based breakfast or topped with soft scrambled eggs.
Pre-steamed sweet potato makes this a 15-minute morning skillet.

recipes.title: Soft Egg, Mild Cheddar & Cilantro-Yogurt Breakfast Wrap
recipes.summary: Warm whole-wheat tortillas spread with cool cilantro-lime Greek yogurt and rolled around fluffy scrambled eggs and melted mild cheese.
steps: Stir plain Greek yogurt, cilantro, lime juice, and a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
Gently scramble eggs in olive oil over low heat 3 minutes, folding in cheddar just before they finish.
Spread cilantro-lime yogurt down the middle of warm tortillas, pile on warm eggs, and roll snugly.
tips: Cilantro-lime yogurt adds cool brightness and moistness in place of heavy sour cream.
Slice in half on a diagonal for tidy hand-held eating.

recipes.title: Cilantro-Lime Quinoa, Black Bean & Sweet Corn Bowl
recipes.summary: Bright restaurant-style bowl tossing fluffy quinoa with olive oil, fresh lime juice, fragrant cilantro, black beans, sweet corn, and tomato.

ingredient_details.item: dried cilantro leaves (or 0.25 cup fresh chopped)

steps: Toss warm cooked quinoa with olive oil, fresh lime juice, cilantro, and a pinch of salt; let stand 3 minutes so the warm grain absorbs the herb aroma.
Fold in rinsed black beans, sweet corn, and diced tomato.
Divide into two bowls and enjoy warm or cool.
tips: Warm quinoa instantly rehydrates dried cilantro leaves and turns every grain fragrant.
Add diced avocado or shredded poached chicken whenever you want extra richness.

recipes.title: Velvety Sweet Carrot, Ginger & Cilantro Soup
recipes.summary: Classic smooth carrot-ginger soup perfumed warmly with dried cilantro, onion, lime, and silky coconut milk.

ingredient_details.item: dried cilantro leaves (plus fresh for garnish if desired)

steps: Simmer sliced carrots, onion, grated ginger, dried cilantro, and vegetable broth 16 to 18 minutes until carrots are fork-tender.
Stir in light coconut milk and blend completely silky with an immersion blender.
Brighten with fresh lime juice right before ladling into warm bowls.
tips: Carrot, ginger, and cilantro are one of the most harmonious gentle soup combinations.
Ultra-smooth and easy to sip or spoon.

recipes.title: Smashed Avocado, Chickpea & Cilantro-Lime Wrap
recipes.summary: Creamy plant-based lunch wrap mashing chickpeas and ripe avocado together with cilantro, fresh lime, finely diced celery, and baby spinach.
steps: Mash rinsed chickpeas and ripe avocado together with lime juice, cilantro, and a pinch of salt.
Fold in finely diced celery and rest 2 minutes so the flavors meld.
Spread across whole-wheat wraps topped with baby spinach, roll snugly, and slice.
tips: No mayonnaise needed—avocado creates a velvety green binding sauce with healthy fats.
Tastes wonderful scooped with soft pita triangles too.

recipes.title: Mild Cilantro-Lime Poached Chicken & Rice Soup
recipes.summary: Light, bright Mexican-inspired lime broth brimming with tender shredded poached chicken, soft cooked rice, tomatoes, avocado, and cilantro.
steps: Simmer chicken broth, diced tomatoes, and dried cilantro 8 minutes to build fragrant flavor.
Add shredded poached chicken and cooked rice and warm gently 4 minutes.
Turn off heat, stir in fresh lime juice, and ladle into bowls topped with diced avocado.
tips: Inspired by Yucatan sopa de lima—bright, restorative, and gently soothing without spicy chiles.
Ready in 20 minutes from pantry staples.

recipes.title: Crisp Cucumber, Sweet Mango & Cilantro-Lime Salad
recipes.summary: Refreshing colorful midday salad pairing juicy diced mango, cucumber, protein-rich edamame, lime juice, olive oil, and fragrant cilantro.
steps: Whisk lime juice, extra-virgin olive oil, cilantro, and a pinch of salt; rest 3 minutes so the herb infuses the dressing.
Combine baby spinach, diced mango, cucumber, and shelled edamame in a bowl.
Drizzle with the bright cilantro-lime vinaigrette and toss lightly.
tips: Thawed frozen mango chunks work beautifully when fresh mangoes are under-ripe.
Cooling, sweet-tart, and packed with plant protein.

recipes.title: Cilantro-Lime Baked Cod with Warm Coconut-Infused Rice
recipes.summary: Moist, flaky baked white fish brushed with garlic, olive oil, lime, and aromatic cilantro, served over tender mild coconut-cilantro rice.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; mix olive oil, minced garlic, half the lime juice, and 1 tsp dried cilantro, and brush over cod fillets.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until cod flakes softly.
Fold warm light coconut milk, remaining lime juice, and remaining 1 tsp cilantro into hot cooked rice and serve under the flaky fish.
tips: Folding a splash of warm coconut milk into cooked jasmine rice gives instant creamy coconut rice without a separate pot.
Naturally dairy-free and very gentle to chew.

recipes.title: One-Pan Cilantro-Lime Braised Chicken & Zucchini
recipes.summary: Tender chicken thighs simmered in savory broth with garlic, cumin, dried cilantro, lime juice, and soft zucchini slices.

ingredient_details.item: dried cilantro leaves (plus fresh garnish if desired)

steps: Brown chicken thighs lightly in a greased skillet 3 minutes per side, then stir in garlic, cumin, dried cilantro, and chicken broth.
Cover and simmer 8 minutes, add zucchini slices, and cover 5 minutes more until chicken hits 165 F and zucchini is fork-tender.
Finish with fresh lime juice and spoon pan juices over warm rice or mashed sweet potatoes.
tips: Braising dried cilantro directly in broth softens the leaves and permeates the entire sauce.
Serve with diced avocado on the side.

recipes.title: Mild Indian Red Lentil Dal with Ginger, Turmeric & Cilantro
recipes.summary: Velvety, comforting red lentil dal gently spiced with ginger, cumin, turmeric, and generous aromatic cilantro over warm basmati rice.
steps: Saute diced onion in 1 tbsp oil for 4 minutes until soft, then stir in garlic, ginger, and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add rinsed red lentils, vegetable broth, and half the cilantro; simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until creamy and soft.
Fold in the remaining cilantro and a squeeze of lemon or lime and ladle over warm rice.
tips: Red lentils break down naturally into a silky, comforting porridge with zero soaking.
Completely mild, warm, and high in gentle plant fiber.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Cool Cilantro-Lime Avocado Crema
recipes.summary: Tender baked salmon fillets served with a silky blended avocado, Greek yogurt, lime, and cilantro sauce alongside warm black beans.
steps: Brush salmon lightly with olive oil and bake at 400 F for 12 minutes until flaky.
Blend or mash avocado, Greek yogurt, lime juice, cilantro, and 2 tbsp water until smooth and bright green.
Serve warm salmon alongside warmed black beans topped with cool spoonfuls of cilantro-avocado crema.
tips: Cool silky avocado crema makes lean salmon taste luxurious and keeps every bite moist.
Add a pinch of cumin to the black beans for warm depth.

recipes.title: Soft Roasted Sweet Potato, Black Bean & Cilantro Tacos
recipes.summary: Caramelized sweet potato cubes and warm cumin black beans tucked into soft warm tortillas with bright cilantro-lime cabbage slaw.

ingredient_details.item: small soft corn or whole-wheat tortillas

steps: Roast sweet potato cubes tossed with olive oil and half the cilantro at 400 F for 18 minutes until golden and fork-tender.
Toss finely shredded cabbage with lime juice and remaining cilantro and rest 5 minutes to soften.
Fill warm soft tortillas with roasted sweet potatoes, warm black beans, and bright cilantro-lime slaw.
tips: Soft corn or whole-wheat tortillas are easy to fold and gentler to chew than hard taco shells.
Serve as a taco bowl over rice whenever you prefer using a fork.

recipes.title: Tropical Pineapple, Lime & Cilantro Refresher Smoothie
recipes.summary: Zesty green smoothie blending frozen pineapple, baby spinach, bright cilantro, banana, lime juice, and coconut water.

ingredient_details.item: dried cilantro leaves (or 2 tbsp fresh leaves)

steps: Blend coconut water, baby spinach, and cilantro 20 seconds until completely smooth.
Add frozen pineapple, banana, and fresh lime juice.
Blend 35 seconds more until frothy bright green and pour chilled.
tips: Sweet pineapple and tangy lime transform cilantro into a crisp, spa-like tropical note.
Naturally dairy-free and super hydrating.

recipes.title: Creamy Mango, Avocado & Cilantro-Lime Smoothie
recipes.summary: Lush pastel-green tropical smoothie uniting frozen mango, creamy ripe avocado, oat milk, fresh lime, and delicate cilantro.
steps: Place oat milk, frozen mango, ripe avocado, lime juice, and cilantro in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until luxuriously smooth and frothy.
Serve immediately in a chilled glass.
tips: Mango, avocado, and cilantro are a natural tropical trio that blends into a velvety, mildly sweet drink.
Add 1 tsp honey if your mango is tart.

recipes.title: Cool Cucumber, Ripe Pear & Cilantro Spa Smoothie
recipes.summary: Light, ultra-refreshing garden smoothie blending ripe sweet pear, cool cucumber, fresh ginger, cilantro, lemon, and cold water.
steps: Combine cold water, diced ripe pear, chopped cucumber, grated ginger, lemon juice, cilantro, and 5 ice cubes in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until pale green, icy, and completely smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy right away.
tips: Sweet juicy pear balances crisp garden cucumber and herbal cilantro gently.
Light, hydrating, and dairy-free.

recipes.title: Blueberry, Spinach, Orange & Cilantro Antioxidant Smoothie
recipes.summary: Polyphenol-rich purple smoothie blending frozen blueberries, orange juice, baby spinach, cilantro, Greek yogurt, and banana.
steps: Blend fresh orange juice, baby spinach, and cilantro 20 seconds until completely smooth.
Add Greek yogurt, frozen blueberries, and banana and blend 35 seconds more until rich violet.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Sweet orange and blueberry completely soften cilantro's herbal note for a clean berry finish.
Packed with colorful plant phytonutrients.

recipes.title: Chilled Cantaloupe, Lime & Cilantro Summer Smoothie
recipes.summary: Sunny peach-toned smoothie combining sweet ripe cantaloupe, plain yogurt, lime juice, honey, ice, and a refreshing whisper of cilantro.
steps: Add cantaloupe cubes, Greek yogurt, fresh lime juice, honey, cilantro, and ice cubes to a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until frosty, airy, and velvety smooth.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Cantaloupe and lime pair effortlessly with mild cilantro for a refreshing warm-weather treat.
Omit honey when melon is peak-season sweet.

recipes.title: Crisp Cucumber, Lime & Cilantro Agua Fresca
recipes.summary: Traditional Mexican-style chilled cucumber-lime juice infused with cilantro and lightly sweetened with honey, strained crystal clear.
steps: Blend chopped cucumber, chilled water, fresh lime juice, honey, and cilantro 25 seconds.
Strain through a fine-mesh sieve into two ice-filled glasses for a crisp, spotless pour.
Serve icy cold right away.
tips: Straining removes dried herb flecks while keeping every bit of crisp citrus-cilantro aroma.
Ultra-hydrating on warm days.

recipes.title: Golden Pineapple, Celery & Cilantro Green Press
recipes.summary: Zesty green juice blending crisp celery, sweet pineapple juice, fresh lime, and bright cilantro, strained clean over ice.
steps: Blend pineapple juice, chopped celery, chilled water, lime juice, and cilantro 25 seconds.
Strain cleanly through a fine-mesh sieve, pressing with the back of a spoon.
Pour over ice and enjoy crisp.
tips: Sweet pineapple softens celery's grassy edge and lifts cilantro's bright aroma.
No juicer needed—just blend and strain.

recipes.title: Chilled Watermelon, Lime & Cilantro Cooler
recipes.summary: Vibrant ruby watermelon juice infused cleanly with lime juice and cilantro, strained silky smooth over ice.
steps: Blend seedless watermelon cubes, lime juice, chilled water, and cilantro 20 seconds.
Strain through a fine sieve into a pitcher to catch any herb flecks.
Pour over ice and sip refreshing and cold.
tips: Naturally sweet with zero sugar added.
Add a tiny pinch of flaky sea salt on hot days for natural electrolyte lift.

recipes.title: Sunny Orange, Carrot & Cilantro Citrus Press
recipes.summary: Golden carrot and freshly squeezed orange juice briefly pulsed with ginger and cilantro and strained clean into a bright morning glass.
steps: Pulse orange juice, carrot juice, grated ginger, lime juice, and cilantro in a blender 15 seconds.
Pour through a fine-mesh strainer into an ice-filled glass.
Serve immediately while crisp and fragrant.
tips: A tiny infusion of cilantro adds restaurant-level citrus sophistication to sweet carrot-orange juice.
Straining guarantees an effortless silky sip.

recipes.title: Savory Garden Tomato, Lime & Cilantro Press
recipes.summary: Crisp chilled salsa-inspired sipping tomato juice blended bright with fresh lime, celery, cumin, and fragrant cilantro, strained silky.
steps: Pulse tomato juice, fresh lime juice, cilantro, cumin, and black pepper 15 seconds in a blender.
Strain through a fine sieve over ice for a smooth, crisp finish.
Garnish with a lime wedge and enjoy chilled.
tips: Zero chile heat while capturing all the bright zesty charm of fresh garden pico de gallo.
A great low-sugar midday pick-me-up.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Golden Turmeric, Cumin & Celery Stalk Morning Barley Bowl
recipes.summary: Warm savory pearl barley simmered with finely diced celery stalk, golden turmeric, earthy cumin, cracked black pepper, olive oil, and generous bright fresh cilantro.

ingredient_details.item: chopped fresh cilantro leaves and tender stems

steps: Warm half the olive oil in a saucepan over medium-low heat and soften finely diced celery stalk with ground turmeric, cumin, and cracked black pepper for 3 minutes.
Stir in cooked pearl barley and vegetable broth; simmer gently for 8 minutes until warm, creamy, and spoon-soft.
Turn off heat, fold in chopped fresh cilantro and remaining olive oil, and spoon into warm breakfast bowls.
tips: Tender cilantro stems hold extra fresh aroma and soften smoothly when folded into warm grain bowls.
Using pre-cooked barley delivers steady soluble fiber in just 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Flaked Poached Salmon, Ginger & Sesame Morning Congee
recipes.summary: Soothing morning rice porridge cooked with grated fresh ginger and rice bran oil, topped with tender flaked poached salmon, fragrant fresh cilantro, and toasted sesame oil.
steps: Simmer cooked jasmine rice, vegetable broth, grated fresh ginger, and rice bran oil for 14 minutes until silky and porridge-soft.
Gently stir in flaked poached salmon for 2 minutes off-boil so it warms without flaking apart.
Ladle into warm bowls and top generously with chopped fresh cilantro and a drizzle of toasted sesame oil.
tips: Fresh cilantro wakes up rich morning salmon congee with clean herbal brightness.
Ultra-soft, warm, and hydrating to start the day calmly.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Nigella Seed, Cumin & Poached Chicken Soft Egg Scramble
recipes.summary: Fluffy low-heat scrambled eggs infused in olive oil with toasted nigella seed, warm cumin, cracked black pepper, shredded poached chicken, and abundant fresh cilantro.
steps: Whisk eggs with 1 tbsp water, ground cumin, and freshly cracked black pepper.
Warm olive oil over low heat with nigella seeds for 30 seconds until fragrant, add shredded poached chicken for 1 minute, then pour in the eggs.
Fold gently 2 to 3 minutes until moist soft curds form, turn off heat, and fold in fresh chopped cilantro before plating.
tips: Nigella seeds give a warm roasted-onion perfume that pairs naturally with eggs and fresh cilantro.
Keeping burner heat gentle guarantees plush curds that are easy to swallow.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Sweet Orange, Sumac & Olive-Oil Savory Avocado Ricotta Toast
recipes.summary: Whole-grain toast layered with whipped ricotta and mashed avocado, crowned with sweet orange segments, fresh chopped cilantro, ruby ground sumac, olive oil, and black pepper.
steps: Mash ripe avocado smoothly with ricotta cheese, half the chopped cilantro, and cracked black pepper.
Spread the creamy green mixture evenly across warm lightly toasted whole-grain bread.
Top with juicy diced sweet orange, the remaining fresh cilantro, ruby ground sumac, and a drizzle of olive oil.
tips: Combining creamy ricotta with avocado yields a velvety high-protein topping that holds neatly on toast.
Sweet orange and tart sumac echo fresh cilantro's citrusy charm.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Chilled Cantaloupe, Spearmint & Flaxseed-Oil Yogurt Bowl
recipes.summary: Cool morning bowl combining plain Greek yogurt and flaxseed oil with ripe diced cantaloupe, finely snipped fresh cilantro, cool spearmint leaves, and grated ginger.
steps: Swirl grated fresh ginger and cold-pressed flaxseed oil smoothly into plain Greek yogurt inside a chilled bowl.
Top with soft cubes of sweet ripe cantaloupe.
Scatter finely snipped fresh cilantro and spearmint over the melon and enjoy cool.
tips: Fresh cilantro pairs surprisingly beautifully with sweet melon, echoing classic Mexican fruit cups.
Snip tender herb leaves directly over the bowl with kitchen shears for effortless prep.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Fresh Shiso, Ginger & Poached Chicken Sesame Barley Bowl
recipes.summary: Fragrant Asian-inspired grain bowl tossing tender pearl barley and shredded poached chicken with abundant fresh cilantro, crisp shiso ribbons, grated ginger, and toasted sesame oil.
steps: Whisk toasted sesame oil, fresh lime juice, and finely grated ginger together in a mixing bowl.
Add cooked pearl barley and shredded poached chicken and toss gently until evenly glossed.
Fold in generous chopped fresh cilantro and snipped fresh shiso leaves right before serving.
tips: Enjoy lightly warm or chilled; pearl barley holds the sesame-ginger dressing without turning soggy.
Fresh cilantro and shiso give lively herbal complexity with zero cooking required.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Sweet Orange, Celery Stalk & Poached Salmon Walnut-Oil Salad
recipes.summary: Bright omega-3 lunch bowl combining flaky poached salmon and fluffy quinoa with sweet orange, finely diced celery stalk, ground cumin, cold-pressed walnut oil, and abundant cilantro.
steps: Whisk cold-pressed walnut oil, juice of half the sweet orange, and ground cumin in a bowl.
Toss cooked quinoa, finely diced celery stalk, and abundant chopped fresh cilantro with the dressing.
Divide into two bowls and arrange sweet orange segments and tender flakes of poached salmon on top.
tips: Sweet orange juice balances nutty walnut oil and bright fresh cilantro effortlessly.
Fluffy quinoa and flaked salmon make every spoonful soft and balanced.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Turmeric, Fennel Seed & Sweet Potato Soup with Pumpkin Seed Oil
recipes.summary: Velvety golden sweet potato soup simmered with fresh ginger, turmeric, lightly crushed fennel seed, and black pepper, finished with fresh cilantro and roasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Simmer diced sweet potato, vegetable broth, grated fresh ginger, ground turmeric, crushed fennel seeds, and cracked black pepper covered 16 minutes until completely tender.
Add half the fresh cilantro and puree with an immersion blender until satin-smooth.
Ladle hot golden soup into two bowls and finish with roasted pumpkin seed oil and the remaining fresh cilantro.
tips: Blending half the cilantro directly into the sweet potato soup infuses fresh herbaceous notes into every spoonful.
Dark roasted pumpkin seed oil creates a striking emerald swirl over golden soup.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Fresh Basil, Tarragon & Red Grape Creamy White Bean Bowl
recipes.summary: Lush no-cook herb garden white bean bowl pairing creamy cannellini beans and quartered red grapes with olive oil, abundant fresh cilantro, torn sweet basil, and delicate tarragon.
steps: Whisk extra-virgin olive oil and fresh lime juice in a mixing bowl.
Gently stir in rinsed cannellini beans (lightly mashing a spoonful so the dressing turns velvety) and quartered red grapes.
Fold in abundant chopped cilantro, torn fresh basil, and chopped tarragon right before serving.
tips: Three fragrant soft herbs make pantry white beans taste like a bright farmer's-market lunch.
Serve alongside soft pita or toasted sourdough for scooping.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Saffron, Ruby Sumac & Olive-Oil Warm Chickpea Couscous
recipes.summary: Fluffy golden couscous steamed in saffron-infused broth with tender chickpeas, finely diced celery stalk, warm cumin, olive oil, ruby sumac, and heaps of fresh cilantro.
steps: Warm half the olive oil in a saucepan and soften finely diced celery stalk with ground cumin for 3 minutes.
Add vegetable broth, crumbled saffron threads, and chickpeas; bring to a boil, stir in couscous, cover tightly, and remove from heat for 5 minutes.
Fluff saffron couscous gently with a fork, drizzle remaining olive oil, and fold in abundant chopped fresh cilantro and ruby ground sumac.
tips: Couscous steams soft and airy off the heat in just 5 minutes with zero stirring.
Fresh cilantro and tart sumac give this warm lunch bowl vivid Moroccan brightness.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Ginger, Mild Sichuan Pepper & Sesame Oil Poached Chicken Rice
recipes.summary: Tender chicken ribbons gently poached in broth perfumed with fresh ginger, rice bran oil, and mild ground Sichuan pepper, finished over jasmine rice with sesame oil and copious cilantro.

ingredient_details.item: fresh cilantro leaves and tender stems

steps: Simmer chicken broth, rice bran oil, julienned fresh ginger, and mild ground Sichuan pepper gently for 4 minutes to perfume the broth.
Slide thinly sliced chicken into the skillet, cover, and poach over low heat for 7 to 8 minutes until tender and opaque.
Spoon warm jasmine rice into bowls, top with poached chicken and aromatic broth, drizzle toasted sesame oil, and shower with abundant fresh cilantro.
tips: Fresh cilantro melts slightly into the hot ginger-Sichuan broth, perfuming every bite.
Use just a gentle quarter-teaspoon of ground Sichuan pepper for citrus-floral aroma without strong tingling.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Saffron, Sweet Orange & Fennel Seed Steamed Salmon Bowl
recipes.summary: Moist skillet-steamed salmon fillets bathed in golden saffron and sweet orange broth scented with lightly crushed fennel seed and olive oil, finished with fresh cilantro.
steps: Warm olive oil over medium-low heat with lightly crushed fennel seeds for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in vegetable broth, fresh orange juice, orange zest, and steeped saffron liquid; nestle salmon fillets inside, cover, and steam gently 9 to 10 minutes until flaky.
Serve salmon and golden pan juices over warm basmati rice crowned generously with fresh chopped cilantro.
tips: Cilantro, saffron, and sweet orange reflect classic coastal Moroccan fish cookery.
Gentle steam keeps salmon fillets effortless to flake with a fork.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Cinnamon, Clove & Cumin Fragrant Chickpea Lentil Stew
recipes.summary: Cozy plant-based stew simmering split red lentils and tender chickpeas in olive oil spiced warmly with ground cinnamon, clove, cumin, and turmeric, finished with abundant cilantro.
steps: Warm olive oil in a pot over medium-low heat and bloom ground cinnamon, cloves, cumin, and turmeric for 45 seconds.
Stir in rinsed red lentils, cooked chickpeas, and vegetable broth; cover and simmer gently 16 to 18 minutes until thick and creamy.
Remove from heat, fold in abundant fresh chopped cilantro, and ladle warm into deep bowls.
tips: Red lentils melt into a thick golden gravy around plump chickpeas with zero blending required.
Fresh cilantro cuts through warm cinnamon and clove with crisp green freshness.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Nigella Seed, Thyme & Turmeric Soft Cauliflower Dal Bowl
recipes.summary: Spoon-soft cauliflower florets and split red lentils cooked in rice bran oil with toasted nigella seed, thyme, golden turmeric, and black pepper, topped generously with cilantro.
steps: Warm rice bran oil over medium-low heat and bloom nigella seeds, fresh thyme leaves, ground turmeric, and cracked black pepper for 45 seconds.
Add finely chopped cauliflower, rinsed red lentils, and vegetable broth; cover and simmer 15 minutes until cauliflower is completely mashable.
Mash lightly with a potato masher for a creamy stew texture, fold in generous fresh chopped cilantro, and serve warm.
tips: Coarsely mashing cooked cauliflower into red lentils creates a silky, comforting supper bowl.
Pre-riced cauliflower works nicely here and shaves off chopping time.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Lemon Balm, Fresh Shiso & Ginger Silken Tofu Broth Bowl
recipes.summary: Calming evening broth bowl warming delicate cubes of silken tofu and soft sliced celery stalk in ginger broth finished with toasted sesame oil, lemon balm, shiso, and cilantro.
steps: Simmer vegetable broth, thinly sliced celery stalks, and grated fresh ginger for 7 minutes until celery is soft.
Lower heat to a bare simmer and slip in soft silken tofu cubes for 3 minutes to warm through delicately.
Spoon warm rice into bowls, ladle tofu and ginger broth around it, and finish with fresh cilantro, snipped lemon balm, shiso, and toasted sesame oil.
tips: Silken tofu requires almost zero chewing while providing calm, complete evening plant protein.
Three cooling fresh herbs turn a quick broth bowl into a serene dinner.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Ripe Cantaloupe, Banana, Ginger & Flaxseed-Oil Green Smoothie
recipes.summary: Creamy hydrating smoothie blending bright fresh cilantro with chilled sweet cantaloupe, ripe banana, zesty fresh ginger, oat milk, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh cilantro leaves and tender stems

steps: Pour chilled oat milk into the blender with fresh cilantro, ripe cantaloupe, frozen banana slices, grated ginger, and flaxseed oil.
Blend on high speed for 45 seconds until completely smooth and light jade-gold.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Sweet cantaloupe and banana soften cilantro into a clean, tropical-tasting green smoothie.
Cold-pressed flaxseed oil blends invisibly into creamy fruit smoothies.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Wild Blueberry, Sweet Orange & Spearmint Antioxidant Smoothie
recipes.summary: Vibrant berry-herb smoothie blending fresh cilantro and cool spearmint leaves with wild blueberries, juicy peeled navel orange, almond milk, and flaxseed oil.
steps: Add almond milk, fresh cilantro, fresh spearmint leaves, peeled sweet orange, frozen blueberries, and flaxseed oil to a blender.
Blend on high for 45 seconds until velvety smooth and deep purple.
Pour into a glass and sip right away.
tips: Blueberries give a gorgeous deep berry color even when paired with generous green cilantro.
Fresh orange and spearmint make this ultra-refreshing after a walk.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Sweet Cherry, Banana & Lemon Balm Herbal Yogurt Smoothie
recipes.summary: Smooth ruby-tinted yogurt smoothie blending fresh cilantro and calming lemon balm leaves with dark sweet cherries, banana, fresh ginger, and plain Greek yogurt.
steps: Combine cold water, Greek yogurt, fresh cilantro, fresh lemon balm leaves, frozen dark sweet cherries, ripe banana, and grated ginger in a blender.
Blend on high speed for 45 seconds until thick, frosty, and smooth.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Lemon balm lends gentle citrus perfume that harmonizes cleanly with cilantro and sweet cherries.
Greek yogurt adds smooth, filling protein.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Green Grape, Tart Raspberry & Fresh Shiso Kefir Smoothie
recipes.summary: Bright probiotic kefir smoothie pairing fresh cilantro and aromatic green shiso with juicy seedless grapes, tart raspberries, and a silky teaspoon of walnut oil.
steps: Blend plain kefir, chilled green grapes, frozen raspberries, fresh cilantro, fresh shiso leaves, and cold-pressed walnut oil on high for 45 seconds.
Strain briefly through a fine sieve if you prefer a completely seed-free raspberry texture.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy fresh.
tips: Seedless green grapes supply gentle natural sweetness without overpowering delicate herbs.
Kefir provides gut-friendly cultures with an easy-drinking texture.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Golden Turmeric, Ginger, Banana & Black Pepper Oat Smoothie
recipes.summary: Energizing golden-green smoothie blending fresh cilantro with sweet navel orange, creamy banana, ground turmeric, grated fresh ginger, a pinch of black pepper, and oat milk.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch of freshly cracked black pepper

steps: Combine chilled oat milk, peeled sweet orange, frozen banana, fresh cilantro, ground turmeric, grated fresh ginger, and a pinch of black pepper in a blender.
Blend on high speed for 45 seconds until completely creamy and smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Just a whisper of cracked black pepper supports turmeric absorption without adding noticeable heat.
Naturally dairy-free and bright with sunny citrus.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Celery Stalk, Sweet Orange, Ginger & Turmeric Fresh Press
recipes.summary: Crisp revitalizing juice pressing fresh cilantro and hydrating celery stalks with sweet navel orange, zesty fresh ginger, golden turmeric, and a whisper of black pepper.

ingredient_details.item: fresh cilantro leaves and tender stems
pinch of finely ground black pepper

steps: Juice fresh cilantro, chopped celery stalks, peeled sweet orange, and ginger (or blend with 1/3 cup cold water for 30 seconds and press through a fine-mesh strainer).
Whisk ground turmeric and a tiny pinch of black pepper briskly into the strained juice.
Serve immediately over two ice cubes.
tips: Fresh navel orange brings natural sweetness that makes green celery-cilantro juice truly enjoyable.
Drink freshly pressed for peak crispness.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Chilled Cantaloupe, Green Grape & Spearmint Garden Juice
recipes.summary: Cool, clean melon-herb press blending fresh cilantro, spearmint, and lemon balm leaves with sweet cantaloupe and seedless green grapes, strained silky smooth.
steps: Blend chilled cantaloupe, seedless green grapes, fresh cilantro, spearmint, lemon balm, and 1/4 cup cold water for 25 seconds.
Strain smoothly through a fine-mesh sieve, pressing gently with a spoon.
Pour into a chilled glass over ice and sip fresh.
tips: Sweet cantaloupe and green grapes yield naturally luscious juice with zero added sweeteners.
A cool, garden-fresh refresher for warm afternoons.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Pressed Celery Stalk, Sweet Cherry & Fresh Basil Ruby Tonic
recipes.summary: Crisp ruby garden press combining fresh cilantro and sweet basil with hydrating celery stalks, 100% cherry juice, and a touch of bright grated fresh ginger.
steps: Blend chopped celery stalks, pure dark cherry juice, fresh cilantro, fresh sweet basil, grated ginger, and 1/4 cup cold water for 30 seconds.
Press through a fine-mesh strainer into a chilled tall glass over ice.
Stir once gently and enjoy immediately.
tips: Sweet dark cherry juice balances mineral-rich celery and lively green herbs beautifully.
Straining ensures a smooth, clear glass with zero fibrous strands.

recipes.title: Cilantro, Blueberry, Raspberry, Shiso & Sumac Pressed Berry Cooler
recipes.summary: Antioxidant-rich pressed cooler pulsing fresh cilantro and aromatic shiso with blueberries, raspberries, tart ruby sumac, and cold water, strained silky smooth.
steps: Blend chilled water, blueberries, raspberries, fresh cilantro, fresh shiso leaves, and ground sumac for 25 seconds.
Strain carefully through a fine-mesh sieve into an ice-filled glass, pressing berry pulp with a spoon to capture all ruby juice.
Serve crisp and cold immediately.
tips: Straining out raspberry seeds yields an effortlessly smooth, vibrant botanical pour.
Tart ground sumac lifts berry sweetness without needing citrus squeezing.

recipes.title: Savory Cilantro, Celery Stalk, Cumin, Black Pepper & Mild Cayenne Press
recipes.summary: Crisp Southwestern-inspired savory press blending abundant fresh cilantro and celery stalk with low-sodium tomato juice, earthy cumin, olive oil, black pepper, and a gentle pinch of cayenne.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch of mild cayenne pepper

steps: Blend chopped celery stalks, chilled tomato juice, fresh cilantro, ground cumin, cracked black pepper, a tiny pinch of cayenne pepper, and olive oil for 30 seconds.
Press smoothly through a fine-mesh strainer into a chilled glass.
Serve immediately over two ice cubes.
tips: Tastes like chilled garden gazpacho in a crisp, easy-to-sip glass.
Keep cayenne to a light pinch so the fresh cilantro and celery stay bright and soothing.
